goal: Test supervised training-only bootstrap plus corrected GRPO on genuine GPU-generated kernels
development_note: Original failures have been inspected. These workloads are separately labeled development tests and excluded from fresh held-out denominators.
training_source: Verified handwritten sources for the eight configured train_ops only; no held-out/development source in targets
prompt: contract_v2, same template and contract for base/SFT/trained
sampling: Raw on-policy temperature=1, top_p=1, top_k=0; 1536-token limit
schedule: Four supervised epochs (32 example updates), then eight GRPO groups of two
training_reward: All non-PASS candidates receive zero training reward; no update from differences between failure classes
stopping_rule: One frozen preregistered schedule per model. No changes from fresh-test outputs. Preserve failures and historical results.
resources: Laptop RTX 5060 and free Colab T4 if quota available; no spending
